### Data Science {.about-title .glyph-chart-dots}

I study how people respond to incentives in energy and transportation, and what their choices do to the wider system. For electric vehicle smart charging, I ran a national choice experiment with 1,356 owners and estimated mixed logit models of what makes them [enroll](/research/2024-sc-adoption): flexibility and recurring payments matter most. I then simulated 10,000 vehicles against California and New York grid load. Managed charging cut California's peak by up to 5.6 GW, and moderate enrollment, not maximum, gave the best [cost efficiency](/research/2025-smc-economy). My methods also include optimization, agent-based and discrete-event simulation, system dynamics, and network analysis.

### Open-Source Software {.about-title .glyph-package}

I develop open-source {{< var rnolink >}} tools for survey design and discrete choice modeling, including [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-surveydown.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}surveydown](/research/2024-surveydown){.about-tool}, a programmable, markdown-based survey platform built on [[]{.glyph .glyph-quarto aria-hidden="true"}Quarto](https://quarto.org/){.about-tool}, [[]{.glyph .glyph-r aria-hidden="true"}Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co/){.about-tool}, and [[]{.glyph .glyph-database aria-hidden="true"}PostgreSQL](https://supabase.com){.about-tool}, and its companion GUI [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-sdstudio.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}sdstudio](/research/2025-sdstudio){.about-tool}. surveydown has more than 180 GitHub stars and 11,000 CRAN downloads, with a methods paper in _PLOS ONE_.

### Agentic AI Engineering {.about-title .glyph-sparkles}

I build software with agentic workflows around [[]{.glyph .glyph-anthropic aria-hidden="true"}Claude Code](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code){.about-tool} and [[]{.glyph .glyph-openai aria-hidden="true"}Codex](https://openai.com/codex/){.about-tool}, extending them with skills, MCP servers, and hooks. I write [tutorials](/blog/2026-03-26-agentic-engineering-1) and share my own [workflows](/blog/2026-05-15-agentic-workflows) on the blog, and run a [workshop](https://pingfan-hu.github.io/2026-agentic-workshop/) at [GW TAI](https://trustworthyai.gwu.edu) for researchers and developers.

With Professor Helveston, I co-founded [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-alkaline.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}Alkaline Software](https://github.com/alkaline-software){.about-tool}, an app development studio where I am the principal engineer. We build desktop apps in Rust with [GPUI](https://www.gpui.rs) using the same workflows. I lead development of our flagship product, [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-emaki.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}Emaki](https://emaki.lol){.about-tool}, an Agentic Development Environment (ADE), and built the studio's reusable app template for macOS, Windows, and Linux and its design system.
